notes.title: New Update Released (Public Version 2.0.0)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce that a new build has just been set live, featuring many corrections and improvements to gameplay. 

We feel the need to thank everyone who supported us over the period of the past 7 months and helped us with making WSJ a better simulation and game, whatever the preferences were.

notes.title: The new update (Public Version 1.8.0)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce that a new build has just been set live, featuring, among others, the following improvements

[list]
[*] Windowed Mode
[*] Turn-Based Gameplay
[*] "The Yearly Crash" fix
[*] "Too profitable short-trading" fix
[*] New balance for the profit made by issuing derivatives
[*] Better adaptations for playing on multiple screens of the same (or roughly the same) resolution
[*] Support for HD Ready resolutions
[/list]

We would also like to thank to everyone who made the effort to report these and other minor bugs via emails or forums and worked with us on resolving them.
Thanks for standing with us.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Store Page Updated - We Are Ready to Roll!
notes.notes:
A final edit to the Store Page has now been submitted to Valve and we are waiting for their review to release the game.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Releasing in 2 weeks!
notes.notes:
We are delighted to announce that we will be releasing the game in the upcoming two weeks.

The past two months have been spent making improvements to the game and making sure that it isn't too easy nor too hard to beat, while keeping eye on the level of sophistication the game mechanics possess. The game is now in what we would call a "ready" state and we cannot wait for your feedback.

Stay tuned

WSJ Developers
